assessments.zone: Rural Dibaya and Lubondaie secteurs (core of the former Kamuina Nsapu insurgency)
assessments.evidence: Heartland of the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu insurgency; militias were defeated and largely surrendered in 2019, and since then order relies on PNC posts, customary chiefs and occasional FARDC deployments. assessments.zone: Tshimbulu, chief town of Dibaya territory
assessments.evidence: Territorial headquarters with PNC commissariat, FARDC and ANR; Tshimbulu was attacked by Kamuina Nsapu militias in 2016-2017 but has been state-held since 2017 and no armed group is reported to hold it. units.CD9102-dibaya: Dibaya territory (Kasaï-Central) comprises the Dibaya, Lubondaie, Bunkonde and Tshikula secteurs; its chief town is Tshimbulu. It is the birthplace of the Kamuina Nsapu insurgency (the chief's seat is in the Dibaya secteur near Tshimbulu), which overran much of the territory in 2016-2017 before being crushed by FARDC operations; most remaining militiamen surrendered in 2019 after the change of president. No armed group is known to hold territory as of 2026; Tshimbulu and the secteur centres are policed by the PNC with FARDC and ANR present, and villages fall under PNC posts and customary chiefs. Assessment relies on background knowledge because live web research was unavailable in this run, so confidence is limited.
